items.snippet: The City of Chesapeake wishes to better understand the unique factors and considerations impacting the potential redevelopment of the former Southeastern Cooperative Educational Programs (SECEP) school site located in Deep Creek. The Deep Creek Area Plan, adop
items.desc: The City of Chesapeake wishes to better understand the unique factors and considerations impacting the potential redevelopment of the former Southeastern Cooperative Educational Programs (SECEP) school site located in Deep Creek. The Deep Creek Area Plan, adopted in May 2026, envisions the former school site as a mixed-use destination for the Deep Creek community, transformed through adaptive reuse of the existing historic school buildings. To access the full Deep Creek Area Plan document and supporting materials, please visit: Deep Creek Area Plan | Chesapeake, VA.At this time, the City invites interested parties to respond to this Request for Information (RFI) to identify the unique site factors and feasibility considerations for the former school property. Through this RFI, the City seeks information from interested parties in the following areas:Considerations for Department of Historic Resources (DHR) historic designation process and adaptive re-use, Environmental/building remediation and rehabilitation factors, Timing and phasing considerations, Feasibility of mixed-use concept(s) for redevelopment options, Considerations for a public park/open space feature.A subsequent procurement process is anticipated where a Request for Proposal (RFP) will be issued for redevelopment proposals to be considered by the City. The results from this RFI process will directly inform the substance and criteria for the future RFP.

items.snippet: The Virginia Department of Social Services (VDSS) seeks proposals to continue the Virginia Whole Family (Two Generation) Pilot Project. The purpose of this RFP is to test, refine, and build the evidence base for Whole Family approaches that improve multi-gener
items.desc: The Virginia Department of Social Services (VDSS) seeks proposals to continue the Virginia Whole Family (Two Generation) Pilot Project. The purpose of this RFP is to test, refine, and build the evidence base for Whole Family approaches that improve multi-generational outcomes and move families out of poverty across diverse communities in the Commonwealth. Under this contract, participating Community Action Agencies will apply established Whole Family practices and pilot targeted interventions, while supporting structured evaluation of impacts on family stability, economic mobility, and coordinated service delivery. VDSS will evaluate pilot activities and disseminate results annually, sharing findings and lessons learned statewide to accelerate the development and adoption of effective Whole Family strategies. items.desc: This solicitation is being conducted on behalf of the Virginia Community College System (VCCS) to include its 23 Community Colleges, System Office, and Shared Services Center. The VCCS entity with immediate need includes Northern Virginia Community College (NVCC). Any of the VCCS entities may, but are not obligated unless otherwise stated, to utilize any contract(s) awarded as a result of this solicitation. A list of VCCS colleges is available online at www.vccs.edu.The Contractor shall furnish all labor, professional expertise, materials, supplies, pharmaceuticals, and necessary equipment to ensure the health, readiness, and welfare of K 9 assets. Refer to the Request for Proposal (RFP) for further details.
